rows.en: You need not destroy anything but the targets to clear.
Only the targets need destroying to clear.
Many drones have launched from a bomber. Would you kindly intercept them?
Many drones have launched from a bomber. Intercept them.
Destroy the carrier, but watch out for the escort ships and Destroid units.
Destroy the carrier, but watch out for escort ships and Destroid units.
Destroy the base, but watch out for the Destroid units.
Destroy the base, but watch out for the Destroid units.
The objective, mind you, is to observe the performance of the YF-19 and YF-21.
The objective is to see how the YF-19 and YF-21 perform.
Attack without holding back.
Don't hold back. Attack!
rows.notes: Whisper nospeech flag, but the transcript matches the shared line; kept.

rows.en: Unmanned enemy aircraft controlled by someone have appeared. Intercept them.
Unmanned enemy craft controlled by someone have appeared. Intercept them.
Destroy the satellite.
Destroy the satellite!
We shall now descend to Earth, hidden among the satellite debris.
We're going down to Earth now, hidden in the satellite debris.
Friendly aircraft are withdrawing, I see.
Friendly aircraft are leaving.
rows.notes: As row 739. Whisper nospeech flag; transcript matches the shared line.

rows.en: Stop the Macross that Sharon is controlling.
Stop the Macross Sharon is controlling!
rows.notes: Transcript 'tomeru na yo' (don't stop) read as 'tomeru no yo' (stop it), as the other operators say.

rows.en: Ignore the singing unidentified craft and concentrate on annihilating the enemy.
Ignore the singing unknown craft and focus on wiping out the enemy.
There are citizens inside the containers. Prevent the enemy's escape at all costs.
There are citizens inside the containers. Stop the enemy escaping at all costs!
Carry the container to a safe place.
Get the container to a safe place!
rows.notes: Transcript 'hakobu na yo' (don't carry) read as 'hakobu no yo' (carry it).

rows.en: Would you protect the Destroids carrying civilians?
Protect the Destroids carrying civilians.
The Destroids carrying civilians are taking damage, I see.
The Destroids carrying civilians are taking damage.
The Destroids carrying civilians have been wiped out.
The Destroids carrying civilians were wiped out.
Retake the fold generator, whatever it takes.
rows.notes: Transcript ends 'dakkan shiyou' (let us retake); most likely 'dakkan seyo' (retake it), Exsedol's order form and the other operators' line.

rows.en: Retake the fold generator, whatever it takes!
Defend the generator unit.
rows.notes: Transcript garbled after 'generator'; read as 'souchi wo bouei seyo' (defend the unit), as the other operators say.

rows.en: Defend the generator unit!
Destroy the generator unit.
Destroy the generator unit!
Defold reaction in nearby airspace.
Defold reaction in nearby airspace.
A large ship has appeared. The enemy flagship, I should think.
A large ship has appeared. It looks like the enemy flagship.
Kinryu has come to back us up, it seems.
rows.notes: Transcript has 'Kinryu taii' (Capt. Kinryu); other operators' transcripts vary (taii / taiin / tai) and the shared English drops the rank. Rank left out.

rows.en: Kinryu has come to back us up!
rows.notes: Transcript 'Kinryu taiin'; rank or title dropped as in the shared clips.

rows.en: Estimated length, 300 meters. Clearly unlike any enemy we have seen so far.
Estimated length, 300 meters. It's clearly unlike any enemy so far.
Docker has come to back us up, it seems.
Docker has come to back us up!
A training unit has appeared, it seems.
A training unit has appeared.
Aircraft sighted. A training unit, I see.
Aircraft sighted. It's a training unit.
The next training unit is coming!
rows.notes: 'enshuu-ki' written with 'period'; read as training unit.

rows.en: The next training unit is coming!
Work with Sound Force and destroy Gepelnitchi.
rows.notes: Name slightly misheard in the transcript; Gepelnitchi.

rows.en: Work with Sound Force and take down Gepelnitchi.
Annihilate the enemies hindering the Spiritia collection.
Wipe out the enemies blocking Spiritia collection.
Enemy contact confirmed. Those samples, I see.
Enemy contact confirmed. It's those samples.
Sample reinforcements are on their way.
Sample reinforcements incoming!
Readings from those samples. Intercept them.
Sample signatures detected. Intercept them.
A great many samples have arrived, it seems.
A large number of samples have arrived.
Numerous samples are approaching.
Many samples are approaching.
These are orders from Lord Gepelnitchi. Annihilate the enemy.
Orders from Lord Gepelnitchi. Annihilate the enemy.
Annihilate the foolish samples who dare defy us.
Wipe out the foolish samples who defy us.
Annihilate the Anima Spiritia together with Lord Gepelnitchi.
Wipe out the Anima Spiritia alongside Lord Gepelnitchi.
Numerous Galaxy Whales have appeared. Patrol unit, launch at once.
Many Galaxy Whales have appeared. Patrol unit, launch immediately.
Graham Hoilie and a civilian craft confirmed.
Graham Hoilie and a civilian craft confirmed.

uncertain: rows 765-766: Kinryu's rank (taii in Exsedol's transcript) left out, as in the shared operator clips; rank not verified.
whisper_doubt: rows 742, 748: 'na yo' read as 'no yo' (positive order)
row 757: garbled, read as 'defend the generator unit'
